dex.text: A scrap of hill figure that peeled itself off the downs to see the world. It leaves white footprints for a week.
dex.fact: Chalk hill figures are cut through the turf to the white chalk beneath, and must be scoured clean every few years or the grass grows back over them.

dex.text: Stands very still with a staff in each hand, guarding a doorway nobody has ever found. Ask it what it is for and it just gets taller.
dex.fact: The Long Man of Wilmington is about 70 metres tall. Long thought prehistoric, digs in 2003 dated him to the 16th or 17th century; he was outlined in yellow bricks in 1874.
